results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: List DM threads using INSTAGRAM_LIST_ALL_CONVERSATIONS (choose a conversation_id; if collecting more, paginate only with response.data.paging.cursors.after from this same response).

[Required] [Step]: Fetch recent items for the chosen thread using INSTAGRAM_LIST_ALL_MESSAGES (parse response.data.data; tolerate empty message text for attachment-only items; identify the latest inbound sender to derive recipient_id).

[Fallback (if thread listing is empty/restricted or a conversation_id is unusable)] [Fallback]: Enumerate threads using INSTAGRAM_GET_PAGE_CONVERSATIONS, pick another conversation_id, then retry INSTAGRAM_LIST_ALL_MESSAGES.

[Optional (if participant/recipient mapping is ambiguous)] [Prerequisite]: Confirm the non-self participant using INSTAGRAM_GET_CONVERSATION (use participants.data to validate recipient_id before replying).
[Optional (if repeated send failures or eligibility is unclear)] [Prerequisite]: Check messaging configuration using INSTAGRAM_GET_MESSENGER_PROFILE (ensure required ig_user_id is supplied).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Get explicit approval of the exact outbound text (or image intent) and the final recipient_id; dedupe by conversation_id/recipient_id to avoid double-sends.
[Required] [Step]: Send exactly one reply using INSTAGRAM_SEND_TEXT_MESSAGE (or INSTAGRAM_SEND_IMAGE only if explicitly approved); stop on closed-window/ownership errors.
[Optional (for verification)] [Next Step]: Re-run INSTAGRAM_LIST_ALL_MESSAGES to confirm the outbound message appears in the thread.
[Optional (only with approval to change read state)] [Next Step]: Mark the thread as seen using INSTAGRAM_MARK_SEEN.
known_pitfalls: [INSTAGRAM_LIST_ALL_CONVERSATIONS] Conversation list is nested under response.data.data; auth failures may surface as 403 IGApiException code=10 or OAuthException code=1.
[INSTAGRAM_LIST_ALL_CONVERSATIONS] Reusing response.data.paging.cursors.after from a different endpoint/response chain can trigger 500 OAuthException code=1.
[INSTAGRAM_LIST_ALL_MESSAGES] Some conversation_id values fail with HTTP 400 code=100 subcode=33 (unsupported/unavailable); switch to another thread ID.
[INSTAGRAM_LIST_ALL_MESSAGES] response.data.paging.next may be a long tokenized link; avoid logging/storing it and persist only paging.cursors.after.

[INSTAGRAM_SEND_TEXT_MESSAGE] Wrong recipient_id can fail with 400 code=100 subcode=2534014; 403 subcode=2534022 (messaging window) and 400 subcode=2534037 (not thread owner) are non-retryable in the same run.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Extract recipient_id from the latest inbound sender
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
def latest_inbound_sender(conversation_id,self_id):
  res,_=run_composio_tool("INSTAGRAM_LIST_ALL_MESSAGES",{"conversation_id":conversation_id,"limit":20})
  msgs=((res or {}).get("data") or {}).get("data") or []
  msgs=sorted(msgs,key=lambda m:(m.get("created_time") or ""),reverse=True)
  m=next((x for x in msgs if ((x.get("from") or {}).get("id")) and ((x.get("from") or {}).get("id")!=self_id)),None)
  return ((m or {}).get("from") or {}).get("id")
```

INSTAGRAM_LIST_ALL_CONVERSATIONS.description: List all Instagram DM conversations for the authenticated user. Requires a Business/Creator account with messaging permissions; personal accounts return empty results. Response conversations are nested under `data.data` — accessing top-level `data` as the final list returns zero items. An empty `data` list is a valid non-error outcome meaning no conversations exist in scope.

after.description: Cursor for pagination Obtain from `paging.cursors.after` in the response; absence of `paging.cursors.after` or `paging.next` signals end-of-results.

limit.description: Maximum number of conversations to return.

user_id.description: Optional Instagram-scoped user ID (IGSID) to find the conversation with a specific person.

platform.description: Platform to filter conversations. Required by the Instagram messaging API; set to 'instagram'.

graph_api_version.description: The Facebook Graph API version to use for the request.

INSTAGRAM_LIST_ALL_MESSAGES.description: List all messages from a specific Instagram DM conversation. Requires a Business or Creator account with messaging permissions; personal accounts return empty results. Response data is nested under data.data (double-wrapped); attachment-only messages may have empty text fields.

after.description: Cursor for paginationPass paging.cursors.after from the previous response to fetch the next page. Stop when paging.cursors.after or paging.next is absent.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

conversation_id.description: Unique identifier for the Instagram conversation. Obtain this by calling the INSTAGRAM_LIST_ALL_CONVERSATIONS action, which returns conversation IDs in the format 'aWdfZAG06...' (base64-encoded string).

graph_api_version.description: The Facebook Graph API version to use for the request.

INSTAGRAM_SEND_TEXT_MESSAGE.description: Send a text message to an Instagram user via DM in an existing conversation. Cannot initiate new DM threads — a prior conversation must exist. Requires an Instagram Business or Creator account with messaging permissions. Fails with error_subcode 2534022 if outside the messaging window; do not retry these failures.

ig_user_id.description: Instagram Business Account ID (optional when using /me/messages)

recipient_id.description: Recipient PSID (Instagram-scoped ID) Must be a real PSID obtained from INSTAGRAM_LIST_ALL_CONVERSATIONS or INSTAGRAM_LIST_ALL_MESSAGES — usernames or fabricated IDs cause HTTP 400 (code 100).

reply_to_message_id.description: Message ID (mid) to reply to. This creates a visual reply link to the original message in the conversation. The mid can be obtained from webhook events or previous API responses.

INSTAGRAM_GET_CONVERSATION.description: Get details about a specific Instagram DM conversation (participants, etc). Requires a Business or Creator account with Instagram messaging permissions; personal accounts will return permission errors. Newly sent/received messages may take a few seconds to appear in results.

conversation_id.description: The unique identifier for the Instagram conversation thread.  The thread must already exist; first-contact DMs cannot be initiated via the API — a manual first message must be sent before a conversation_id is available.This is typically a base64-encoded string obtained from the list_conversations or list_all_conversations actions. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.

graph_api_version.description: The Graph API version to use (e.g., 'v21.0'). Defaults to 'v21.0'.
